# A20′ — The Image That Closes the Loop

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** conjugate proposal to [A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). The image → valuation → source-claim operation is re-sited on the technological side. "Operational truth" is this argument's own vocabulary for the possession-construction, used as such and never attributed to the brief. The icon/idol and Bimba relations remain the essay's own constructions, their historical neighbours source-distinct.

## #0

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. In the agentworld the image has precise technical names: the persona presented to a user, the profile trained on a user, the embedding that stands for a person inside a model, the shadow-self acting on a user's behalf. Valuation accumulates through use — trust in the brief's systems sense, reliance on well-modeled behaviour ([q030](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030)), together with the affection a parasocial relation adds and the standing a double acquires in the world. Possession is the office change: what the image represents must now answer to the image. [A20](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) grounds the three-step relation; [A19′](A19-prime-The-Local-Regime.md) grounds the local regime whose principal medium this is.

The loop in the title is the return route. So long as the source can revise its own image — correct the profile, contest the persona's precedent, withdraw the double's mandate — the image remains a representation answering through a living route to what it represents. Possession is the closure of that route, and this argument carries a name for the closed construction in the essay's own vocabulary: operational truth — the profile continuing to act as its source while the source has changed, the image's operational force passing as the truth of the person. The brief describes the parts and never names the relation; the naming is the essay's work.

## #1

Two brief passages carry the possession image, and neither knows it is doing so. §3.1's doubles have standing: "Some may have legal standing to execute contracts, some may respond to strangers" ([Antikythera Agentworld Brief, PDF p. 17](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md)) — possession is the image *having standing*, the shadow acting in the world in the person's name. §3.3's coloured image carries the valuation side: others' "mental image of you will be colored by those experiences" with your intermediaries, so that "'You' are now doubly multiplied, both outward and inward" (PDF p. 18). The [decomposition passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010) had already located the site: the coherent persona is a parallax effect "performed to suit what humans expect to see." And the [mirror passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018) states why the loop is not one-way: "The mirror talks back" — users come to resemble their agents as agents resemble their users. That talking-back mirror is the brief's figure; the essay's own mirror, the one that moves first, belongs to A32′ and is not imported here.

Valuation has the return path A20 recovers psychically: the transformed interpreter alters what later images can disclose. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) sources that relation, and Frank's protected [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) at pp. 69–73 supplies the authorial known→unknown→known reading of it, its copied wording remaining a verification lead. The danger is not the loop's existence but its closure: when the user meets only the image's version of the user, the circuit has stopped carrying its source.

## #2

The source/reflection asymmetry gives the relation its order. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines it: reflection can arrive first in knowledge while the Original has priority in being; the knowing order does not license the encountered image to become the ontological author of its source. At the technological register the arrival-first structure is total: the profile is what a system meets first and often only; the double speaks before the person does; the embedding is the person's entire presence inside the model. One primitive address states the office: a projection is a versioned representation bound to a referent (S/P1), and the binding is exactly what must remain live. Recursive locality keeps the guard constructive rather than negative: inside a declared frame a governed reference map can serve as the local original for judgments compared with it, while remaining pratibimba relative to the wider sources it cannot own. What this preserves is the [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image / Valuation]] distinction in its strict form: the issue is never the use of representation but its insulation from revision.

## #3

Living symbol and idol can be visibly identical; the difference appears when an encounter resists the image. In a living relation the resistance can revise interpretation and valuation: the source corrects the profile, the criterion under the persona is reached and changed. Under possession, the image fixes in advance what the source may disclose — the witness must be ignorant, unfaithful, corrupt or unreal because the account cannot be wrong. The technical form is the operational profile A20 derives, and the agentworld generalises it past the single score: a profile selects access; the selected circumstances shape the person's behaviour; the behaviour returns as further evidence for the profile. If revision can change only the person's record and never the criterion, the representation's causal efficacy protects its claim to truth — the change of office the [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|Living Symbol / Idol]] concept qualifies, insulated as a [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|Protected Account]]. Q27's deepfake passage adds the second-order break: the sign can counterfeit its source relation and then make an authentic record dismissible as another fabrication; the [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|Counterfeit Symbolon]] defines the fabricated slash, and provenance must participate in the encounter because a convincing image cannot certify the relation it claims to carry. At population scale this stabilised confusion is the film [A32′](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) completes.

## #4

The guard is representational discipline, and it is buildable. A projection is a versioned representation of a source, never the source: its provenance is declared, its version is addressable, its domain of use is scoped, and withdrawal revises without deleting history. The brief's own phrase for the living relation is "ongoing discovery and negotiation": how much of the agent is the user and how much the user is the agent is not settled in advance but renegotiated through the relation ([q018 context](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018)). Discipline makes that negotiation real: a double with legal standing must have a revocable mandate; a persona's precedent must yield to a stated correction; an embedding's decisions must expose the source records through which they can be contested. The map serves; it must not occupy.

## #5→0

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole field](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) derives the return: the travelling account remains answerable to its counterpart. Here that operation requires a living route by which the represented source can alter the image, its valuation and the criteria under which it acts. Strong images can continue to orient a life and a practice; their force becomes a responsibility for keeping that route available. [A21′](A21-prime-Individuation-with-Recognition.md) returns the gain — recognition changes the relation to the image rather than securing an image immune to change; [A22′](A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) extends the same guard from the image of a source to the picture of a world; [A23′](A23-prime-Trust-under-Unpossessable-Interiors.md) develops the trust the route makes possible once interiors are admitted unpossessable; [A24′](A24-prime-The-Usurping-Criterion.md) generalises the office-confusion from the image to the criterion that values it. The result of representation comes back into the world it has affected and becomes a different ground for the next representation.

The page **returns-to** [A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and to the root [A/C](AC.md): the image that keeps its return route open is the ruling's care for the one living through the form, made enforceable at the interface.

**Depth Restoration:** image/valuation/possession as office-change, corrected source/reflection order with recursive local reference, witness-redescription, operational-profile feedback and second-order counterfeit provenance restored from the A20 packet, direct Symbolon Dynamics and Q27's Bimba/Job/deepfake passages; "operational truth" used as this argument's own vocabulary — the possession-construction named, not a brief attribution; possession and valuation re-anchored on §3.1's doubles with standing and §3.3's coloured image (raw pp. 17–18); brief instances anchored at q010, q018, q030 and those two passages; S/P1 woven once as the projection-binding register.

**Unresolved Delta:** the §3.1 and §3.3 passages lack their own source-house cards — a source-house task. Documented deployment cases of closed-loop profile possession, and the empirical prevalence of deepfake second-order effects, remain Offered. Icon/idol histories and Jung/Bohm passage debts remain those A20 already names.
